The founder of Temple University, Dr. Russell H. Conwell, believed that education should be available to anyone on the basis of their intellectual and personal motivation, regardless of their income. 

Temple University's Office of Student Financial Services readily assists all Temple students with the financial aid process, as well as servicing Temple University account balance statements. 

The information provided on this website will assist you in effectively managing your financial aid tasks to contribute to your educational success. Stay ahead of the deadlines to ensure you do not miss out on funding opportunities. Plan ahead for summer enrollment or study abroad to maximize your possibilities and stay on track for graduation.

Questions? Make an appointment with Student Financial Services to speak with a counselor!
